newsitem.title: GERMANY: German industry output slips 0.2 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: German industry output slips 0.2 pct in May.

text.p: German industrial output edged down 0.2 percent in May from the previous month, its first fall since January, the economics ministry said on Wednesday.
The May index of 100.6 was up 1.5 percent from the year-earlier level.
In April, industrial output rose 0.3 percent from the previous month and 3.0 percent from the year-earlier month.
The ministry warned that the May data were likely to be revised downward since May had fewer working days than April, and the April data had been revised sharply upward.

Production of consumer goods rose a strong 5.1 percent from the previous month, but consumer durables fell 3.9 percent. Construction output declined 5.4 percent and mining output was down 6.1 percent.
Production in west Germany fell 0.4 percent from the previous month, while in east Germany it rose 0.3 percent.
